thread:
alex: Heads-up — I found a bunch of runbook curl examples that 404 after the infra shortlink change. Ran a quick ripgrep over `docs/` and got ~8 hits. Anyone want to volunteer a tiny sed PR to swap the shortlink?
monica: thanks for digging in alex — can you dump the paths?
alex: sure: `docs/runbooks/oncall.md`, `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md`, `docs/dedicated/deploy.md`, plus a couple in `handbook/`. I'll paste a pastebin in a sec.
kevin: happy to take `docs/runbooks` and `handbook` this afternoon. leaving `runtime` and `dedicated` to someone else.
alex: link: https://paste.redwood.example/xxx (list of files)
monica: quick approach that worked for me previously: `rg "short\.rwd/" -l docs/ | xargs sed -i "s#short.rwd/OLD#short.rwd/NEW#g"` — test locally then push small PR.
lisa: @kevin want me to open the PR for you so you don't have to muck with branches? I can branch from your fork if you want. :sparkles:
kevin: if it's < 5 lines then go ahead, thanks lisa.
docs-bot: Reminder — tiny doc PRs should include a changelog note and a link to an owner in the PR body (CODEOWNERS).
alex: FYI some of the hits are inside fenced codeblocks (curl examples). We should avoid changing quoted sample output. I filtered with `rg -n "curl .*short\.rwd"` to only touch actual commands.
monica: good catch. maybe run a grep for "```" context first or do a quick script: 
```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
  s=open(p).read()
  if re.search(r"curl .*short\\.rwd", s) and "```" not in s:
    print(p)
PY
```
monica: that prints files with a curl example without code fences — good candidate for sed.
lisa: opened PR https://git.redwood.example/repo/docs/patches/123 with the `runbooks` fixes and tiny changelog. @kevin can you glance?
kevin: lgtm aside from one nit re wording in the changelog. I'll push a one-line tweak.
alex: thanks y'all. Who should claim `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md`? I'll take a look tomorrow morning if no one else grabs it.
monica: I can pick `docs/dedicated/deploy.md` after my stand.
lisa: leaving a quick checklist in the PR template: (1) run `npm run docs:build` locally, (2) verify the curl works, (3) add CODEOWNERS mention.
docs-bot: Ticket created: DOCS-3421 "Replace deprecated shortlink in runbook curl examples" — linked to PRs.
kevin: awesome. scheduling a 10-min tidy slot after lunch to sweep any remaining shortlink occurrences. :calendar:
notes: sed, ripgrep, small PRs, CODEOWNERS, DOCS-3421
